run_ray_serve_hello_deployment: run the Ray Serve HelloDeployment to serve a JSON hello response on an HTTP endpoint
create_ray_serve_deployment: create a Ray Serve deployment class that returns a JSON response with a hello message
bind_ray_serve_app: bind a HelloDeployment instance to create a Ray Serve application variable
review_hellodeployment_class: review the HelloDeployment class and its async __call__ method for handling HTTP requests
refactor_hellodeployment_response: refactor the HelloDeployment __call__ method to return a custom JSON payload instead of hello
